caption:
Spaghetti Bolognese 🍝 

C: 56 | F: 18 | P: 35
Calories: 508 per serving
Serves 4

Ingredients: 
1 tbsp oil
6 garlic cloves minced + 1 tsp garlic paste for that extra zing
1 onion, finely chopped
1 - 2 carrots, finely chopped 
1 capsicum, finely chopped
1 box / 200 grams buttom mushroom
450 grams chicken kheema 
1 tbsp tomato paste
4 - 5 tomatoes, make a puree in the blender
3/4 cup vegetable stock or 1/2 cup water, whatever is available for you
1 tbsp black pepper
1 tbsp dried basil, use fresh chopped basil if available
1 tbsp red chilli flakes
handful of chopped coriander leaves
200 grams spaghetti
grated cheese, as much as you desire :) 

Method:
add the oil to the pan followed by the garlic and onions
add in the carrots, saute and then add mushrooms and cook till water evaporates
add in the capsicum and cook for 2 minutes
add in the chicken kheema and stir together
mix in the tomato paste and tomoto puree
add in the vege stock and salt + black pepper + basil + red chilli flakes and coriander
cover and allow to simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, ensure the kheema is fully cooked
add in the al dente pasta and let it simmer in the pasta for 5 minutes ( i like to use like 60% cooked pasta and let it cook in the bolognese - this adds so much flavour to the pasta and helps thicken the mix
plate up your pasta and top with cheese of your choice :) 

Pro Tips: 
you personally might find this pasta to be a little on the wetter side, just whack your flame on high for 5-6 minutes and it will dry out slightly :) 
add in 2 extra tomatoes to your puree for a thicker sauce as well, i didnt to reduce the macros
reduce the amount of pasta to reduce the carbs
